papers.title: Beyond the solvation default in electrolyte additive design for aqueous zinc metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: By constructing a solvation deviation index and incorporating interfacial effects, the solvation effects of various electrolyte additives are quantitatively elucidated and categorized into distinct regimes.

papers.title: A novel amorphization strategy unlocks fast ionic transport in low-cost halide solid electrolytes for high-loading all-solid-state batteries
papers.abstract_en: A new amorphization method enables effective amorphization of halide and oxyhalide solid electrolytes, enhances ionic conductivity, offers rapid synthesis potential, and achieves an areal capacity of 10.45 mAh cm −2 with high-Ni cathodes.
